# Quick2Learn
> Mathematics & Science coaching institute in Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, India

## About
Quick2Learn is a premier coaching institute founded by Dinesh Singh Rajput
(25+ years in Mathematics education) and co-led by Namita Singh Rajput
(Chemistry & Biology). We offer Classes IX–XII coaching for CBSE & ICSE/ISC
boards with proven 100/100 board results year after year.

## Achievements
- 25+ years of Mathematics teaching experience
- Best Teacher Award 2015
- Teacher Innovation Award 2019
- Recognised by the HRD Minister for CBSE results (2015)
- Consistently producing 100/100 scorers in Board Mathematics

## Courses Offered
- Class IX: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Hindi, History & Civics (CBSE/ICSE)
- Class X: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology (CBSE/ICSE)
- Class XI: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry (CBSE)
- Class XII: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry (CBSE)

## Faculty
- **Mr. Dinesh Singh Rajput** — Senior Mathematics Educator & Director (25+ years experience)
- **Mrs. Namita Singh Rajput** — Chemistry & Biology Educator (ICSE specialist)

## Teaching Methodology
- Concept-first approach with structured diagrams and reaction mechanisms
- Dedicated doubt-clearing sessions
- Board-ready question practice and one-shot revision lectures
- Both offline (in-person in Mathura) and online batches available

## Free Resources
- YouTube channel with full-length chapter lectures
- Free lecture library covering all chapters across Classes IX–XII
- One-shot revision videos for board exam preparation
